evidence_scope: criterion_ids identify relevant comparison views, not proof that a criterion passes. PNGs are unretouched browser captures. Finite samples cannot prove unseen states, source facts or continuous behavior. Keep the original rubric; use needs_review if missing evidence determines the GSB decision.

comparison_limits.not_established: Only successful and partial-failure result views are published. Absence of distracting animation and backend functionality cannot be established from these stills.

scenes.title: Successful query and price emphasis
steps: Open the reference with fresh browser storage at /.
Select the built-in normal-success query sample and start the local simulated promotion query.
Wait for the local simulated query to finish, displaying promotion and real-time price results.

steps: Open the reference with fresh browser storage at /.
Run the built-in partial-failure sample and inspect result/error presentation.
